# Bella Real Estate

> Bella Real Estate is Bella's real estate business in Da Nang, Vietnam. Bella rents apartments in Sam Tower, The Ponte, Panoma 1 and Panoma 2, brokers apartment sales, and manages apartments for owners.

Bella has worked in Da Nang real estate for 10 years, renting and selling apartments with a focus on foreign clients. She manages owners' apartments in Sam Tower, The Ponte, Panoma 1 and Panoma 2.

The site does not list individual units. Availability changes constantly: message Bella on WhatsApp or Zalo and she replies with the apartments free right now and their photos. Every apartment is furnished. Bella shows apartments in person, or by video call before you arrive.

## Buildings and starting prices (USD per month)

- [Sam Tower](https://TODO-domain/residences/sam-tower) (Hải Châu · Han Riverside): 1 Bedroom: starting at $690 / month; 2 Bedrooms: starting at $920 / month; 3 Bedrooms: starting at $1,420 / month
- [The Ponte](https://TODO-domain/residences/the-ponte): 1 Bedroom: price on request; 2 Bedrooms: price on request; 3 Bedrooms: price on request
- [Panoma 1](https://TODO-domain/residences/panoma-1): Studio: price on request; 1 Bedroom: starting at $850 / month; 2 Bedrooms: price on request; 3 Bedrooms: starting at $1,730 / month
- [Panoma 2](https://TODO-domain/residences/panoma-2): Studio: price on request; 1 Bedroom: starting at $890 / month; 2 Bedrooms: starting at $1,540 / month; 3 Bedrooms: starting at $2,120 / month
